name: Okapi
body:
OKAPI
CR 1/4

You see a brown animal with zebra-like markings on its legs, but a face more reminiscent of a giraffe’s.

XP 100
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 hooves +3 (1d4+2)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Dodgeb, Mobilityb, Run
Skills Perception +10, Stealth +7; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm forests
Organization solitary
Treasure none

Sometimes called a “forest giraffe” or “zebra giraffe,” though their necks are not nearly so long as their more famous cousins, this quadrupedal herbivore has a glossy coat of chocolate brown to black on its upper body and zebra-like stripes on its legs and rump. Males have short, stubby horns, and some have confused them for a type of unicorn, but they are simple fruit-eating beasts. They are solitary animals, coming together only to breed.
